reviews.name: Nitya K.
reviews.text: Our Thailand trip was a great experience, thanks to Pratik at The Real Tours and Travels. The arrangements were seamless, and what really stood out was Pratik’s personal involvement. He was just a call away throughout the trip, always ready to answer questions or step in whenever we needed help. That kind of support makes travelling so much more relaxing. Would definitely recommend them!
